in_marathi.name: Kripashankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cruel (Kripa) + God (Ishvara) + Mercy (Shankar)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kripashankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। This name is derived from the words Kripa, Ishvara, and Shankar. Kripa means cruel or merciful, Ishvara represents God or the supreme being, and Shankar signifies mercy or compassion. The name Kripashankar therefore embodies the idea of a powerful, compassionate deity.

The name Kripashankar therefore embodies the idea of a powerful, compassionate deity.
